courses.overview: 以下是有共同物理與介面的延伸課程；每項都指出不可直接照搬的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: These extensions share physics/interfaces; each identifies a boundary that prevents direct copying.

related.title: 馬達磁場導向控制
related.difference: 無感測估測增加不可觀測區和參數誤差

practice: 以「dq 模型與殘差修正」建立兩課的共同介面圖，標示訊號、能量與單位。
用本課教學算例改變一個輸入，列出轉移到「馬達磁場導向控制」時需補充的資料。
針對「無感測估測增加不可觀測區和參數誤差」設計一個反例；先預測，再以合成資料或公開量測驗證。
practiceEn: Draw the shared interface for dq models and residual correction, labeling signals, energy and units.
Change one input in this course’s worked example and list additional data needed for Field-oriented motor control.
Design a counterexample to the transfer boundary: Sensorless estimation adds unobservable regions/parameter errors. Predict first, then check using synthetic data or public measurements.

courses.summary: 本課聚焦反電勢觀測器、低速可觀測性與估測融合。地圖提供公開研究或產業交流的背景；本課的模型和假設不宣稱在該處實測、發明或量產。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on back-EMF observers, low-speed observability and estimator fusion. The map provides public research/industry context; course models and assumptions are not claimed to have been measured, invented or manufactured there.

history.title: TI 名稱形成
history.text: 官方資料記錄公司源於 1930 年的 GSI，1951 年更名為 Texas Instruments；本課以其公開控制文件連結元件與機電系統。
history.textEn: Official records trace the company to GSI in 1930 and the Texas Instruments name in 1951; this course uses public control documentation to connect devices with electromechanical systems.

history.title: 積體電路成為控制技術基礎
history.text: TI 官方歷史記載 Jack Kilby 在 1958 年的積體電路工作。今天的即時馬達控制結合量測、計算和功率元件；地圖代表控制產業脈絡，不是本課所有設備產地。
history.textEn: TI’s history records Jack Kilby’s integrated-circuit work in 1958. Modern real-time motor control combines sensing, computation and power devices; this map indicates industry context, not the origin of all course equipment.

courses.connection: 從建立電壓模型的課程問題出發，依來源追溯研究、元件供應與系統驗證的分工；代表地點不等於完整供應鏈。
courses.connectionEn: Start with build voltage models and trace roles in research, components and system validation; the reference location does not represent the entire supply chain.
